summary: Fixed, never closed. Reported repro is a private shader behind an internal PIX bug number and was not obtainable; an agent-constructed reconstruction (compute shader, -Od -Zi, local array in a non-inlined helper) run through dxopt -dxil-dbg-value-to-dbg-declare -dxil-annotate-with-virtual-regs fails on v1.5.2010 and succeeds on v1.6.2104 through main. Fix is almost certainly ac5630e8e (#3292, "Fixes for adding -Od", Dec 2020), which replaced setDebugLoc(GetVariableLocation()) - a DILocation with no inlinedAt and column 1, exactly the shape in the reported dump - with the originating instruction DebugLoc. Attribution is source reasoning over the release window, not a bisect.
title: PIX: Numbering pass fails with /Od when subroutines are used
